fusions.name: Herd Closes Ranks
fusions.desc: Sweeps a full circle that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocks each back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises +8% per ally within 5.5 tiles (max +40%).

fusions.name: Close to the Root
fusions.desc: A low cut that deals 4 damage, heals you for 30% of the damage dealt and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Meadow
fusions.desc: Cuts a clearing 3 tiles around where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Chewing the Cud
fusions.desc: Every kill builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you heal for 4% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
